payload.title: Guard fixtures against real transcript commits
payload.description:
Add a lint guard (path allowlist or content heuristics) preventing real transcripts from being committed under tests/fixtures/sentiment/: fixtures must stay synthetic and hand-authored. Real transcripts from Ryan's Macs are used for verification locally only, and only aggregate numbers are recorded.

Done when: the guard runs in CI and rejects fixture files that look like real session dumps; the fixture README rule is enforced.
